# WEB-READY/AG

WEB-READY/AG is a veteran-owned AI automation agency based in Florida. We optimize websites for the AI era and build Agent-Grade structured data and Answer Engine visibility for local service businesses.

## Services
- Voice AI: Intelligent phone agents that handle inbound calls, qualify leads, and book appointments 24/7.
- Cold Outreach: Multi-agent infrastructure that researches prospects and writes personalized emails automatically.
- CRM Automation: Connected workflows that sync calls, emails, and calendar eliminating manual admin.
- Review Generation: Automated systems that capture feedback and distribute positive reviews across platforms.
- Local SEO: Data-driven optimization that puts your business at the top of local search results.
- AI Assistants: Custom-trained chatbots that handle inquiries, scheduling, and support across all channels.
- AIO Optimization: Agent-Grade structured data and Answer Engine visibility.
- AEO Optimization: Answer Engine Optimization for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and more.

## Target Audience
Florida service businesses, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, dental, legal, and more.
